statement.notes: 1. 'revenue' mapped from 'Total Revenues'. 2. 'operating_expenses' calculated as sum of 'Selling and marketing expenses' and 'General and administrative expenses' (excluding 'Cost of revenues' and 'Other gains/(losses), net' which are separate components of operating profit). 3. 'net_come' mapped from 'Profit for the year'. 4. 'taxes' mapped from 'Income tax expense'. 5. 'interest_expenses' mapped from 'Finance costs'. All values converted to negative numbers where shown in parentheses in the statement.
